title: exemplar with no trace_id shows 'No trace_id on this exemplar'
verifies: an exemplar with no trace_id resolves to the 'none' state, shows the no-trace message, sends zero trace lookups, and offers no open-trace button

title: trace lookup failure shows the unverified button with its reason
verifies: a 403 trace lookup shows the unverified open-trace button with data-reason forbidden, and a delayed lookup past the 8s cap shows data-reason timeout

title: value above the y-extent clamps the marker to the top and shows the clamped note
verifies: an exemplar value above the series y-max clamps the marker to the top (data-clamped=top) and shows the above-range note
